name: ai-workflow-builder
description: Plain-English to visual node graph to executable automation pipeline

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @awb/core && concurrently -n core,api,worker,web -c gray,green,yellow,cyan "npm:dev:core" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @awb/core && npm run build -w @awb/api && npm run build -w @awb/worker && npm run build -w @awb/web
